review_candidates.title: Forwarding Executive Specialist
review_candidates.job_function: Administrative, Customer Service, and Supply Chain
review_candidates.description: Wat ga je doen? Als Forwarding Executive Specialist bij Sealiner, een dochteronderneming van MSC, ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de complete afwikkeling van expeditiedossiers voor diverse transportmodi, evenals uiteenlopende klanten en goederenstromen (FCL, LCL). In deze rol blink je uit in multitasking! Je onderhoudt proactief communicatie met alle betrokken partijen, zoals klanten/agenten en leveranciers, om hen op de hoogte te houden van het verloop van de zending. Naast commerciële zendingen ben je samen met je team verantwoordelijk voor de scheepsgerelateerde zendingen. Verder gooi je af en toe ook je commerciële skills in de strijd en speel je continu in op de wensen van je klanten. Het opsporen van nieuwe kansen is jouw tweede natuur! Offertes opstellen? Easy peasy voor jou. Zelfstandigheid, ad-hoc beslissingen nemen, problemen tackelen, goed met cijfers omgaan en nauwkeurigheid zijn voor jou geen opties maar absolute must-haves in je job. Bij Sealiner, waar we de waarden van ons moederbedrijf MSC omarmen, ben je onderdeel van een bedrijf dat zich kenmerkt als een hechte familie. Onze inzet voor mensen uit zich in zorgvuldige aandacht voor iedereen binnen onze organisatie. We streven voortdurend naar verbetering, waarbij we geloven in de kracht van continue evolutie. Passie is de drijvende kracht achter ons werk, en we moedigen een enthousiaste benadering van elke taak aan. We geloven sterk in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. Of je nu een doorgewinterde professional bent of aan het begin van je carrière staat, we waarderen en bevorderen diversiteit en gelijkheid. In deze rol geef je updates aan de teamleider en draag je actief bij aan het versterken van de bedrijfswaarden. Wees klaar voor een dynamische omgeving waarin jouw inzet het verschil maakt! Wie ben je? Je hebt bij voorkeur een bachelordiploma (of logistieke opleiding) of bent equivalent door ervaring. Bij voorkeur heb je 5 jaar ervaring, maar voor ons zijn motivatie en werkpassie doorslaggevende factoren. Je functioneert perfect in een omgeving waarin geen enkele dag hetzelfde is: you get the job done. Je bent communicatief waardoor je zonder problemen in staat bent om solide klantenrelaties op te bouwen. Strakke deadlines motiveren jou juist Je bent een pro in prioriteiten stellen en kan anticiperen op elke situatie. Klantgerichtheid staat voorop, en je streeft naar een optimale dienstverlening. Administratieve werkzaamheden zijn jou niet vreemd, en precisie is een belangrijk aspect van jouw werk. Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels is vereist. Kennis van Frans en/of Duits is een plus. Je bent commercieel sterk Je bent een waardevolle teamplayer. Wat bieden we jou? Welkom bij de MSC-familie, waar 'familie' meer is dan slechts een woord; het is een gevoel. Bij ons zijn passie, evolutie en gelijke kansen niet alleen waarden, maar onze manier van leven. Onze werkomgeving bruist van energie en is nooit saai, met flexibele uren voor de ultieme balans tussen werk en privé. Geniet van epische afterwork-activiteiten en ontspannen momenten met jouw MSC-squad. Je kunt niet alleen een marktconform salaris verwachten, maar ook een met extra voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, hospitalisatieverzekering en nog veel meer. Bovendien krijg je volop kansen om jezelf te upgraden met eersteklas opleidingen, waardoor je jouw werk naar nieuwe hoogten kunt tillen. Wordt lid van onze familie en ervaar een werkomgeving die echt uniek is. Klinkt goed? Klik dan snel op de "apply-knop" en wie weten horen we elkaar snel! Opmerking : MSC Belgium is actief in de maritieme sector, wat betekent dat een veiligheidscontrole deel uitmaakt van het aanwervingsproces. Heb je hier vragen over? Neem gerust contact met ons op! #MovingTheWorldTogether

review_candidates.title: Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software. As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies. Responsibilities System Identification: Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds. Control Law Design & Tuning: Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope. Sim-to-Real: Keep the in-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft. Model Consumption: Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control. Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior control and GNC engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, controls, robotics, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification & Control: Proven, hands-on identification and control on multirotor or fixed-wing platforms, validated in flight, with depth in at least one of MPC, INDI, or geometric control. Embedded Realization: Real-time control implementation on constrained targets, split cleanly between a microcontroller and a companion computer. Learning-Based Control: Familiarity with reinforcement learning and simulation-based training, and the judgment to know when a learned policy beats a classical design. Professional Attributes: Empirical and hardware-honest, disciplined about experiments and validation, grounded in real flight data. Communicates clearly, able to present control and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Bonus: Multi-airframe or hover-to-cruise transition experience. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

review_candidates.description: Role and Facility Information WILLIAMS LAKE, BC Located in BC's Central Interior, Williams Lake sits in the heart of the Cariboo Chilcotin region, home to the famous annual Stampede. Serving a population of approximately 35,000, the area is part of the broader Cariboo Regional District, which encompasses 62,000 residents. With its many lakes, rivers, and extensive hiking and biking trails, Williams Lake and the surrounding area provide an ideal destination for outdoor enthusiasts to camp, fish, hunt, and play during the summer months. In the winter, residents and visitors alike enjoy snowmobiling, skiing, snowboarding, and ice fishing. Williams Lake has something for everyone! PRACTICE Join our collegial emergency medicine team in Williams Lake! In our 24/7 ED, you’ll help manage approximately 22,000 visits per year. With a diverse range of cases and numerous procedural opportunities, you’ll also collaborate with specialists in internal medicine, obstetrics and gynecology, general surgery, pediatrics, and psychiatry. In our ED, you’ll have the opportunity to teach and mentor medical students and residents as part of the UBC Faculty of Medicine’s rural teaching program. The medical community offers numerous opportunities to expand your scope of practice based on your interests. For those interested, Leadership Development Opportunities are available with Interior Health’s NAVIG8 Program. The NAVIG8 Emerging Physician Leaders Program is a comprehensive leadership development program designed specifically for physicians to address the practical leadership knowledge, behaviours and skills that high potential, emerging medical leaders require to step into leadership roles early in their careers. The CMH redevelopment project will expand the hospital, adding a new building with an upgraded emergency department featuring 23 treatment spaces. By 2029, CMH will feature new medical-surgical, mental health, and maternity units, expanded oncology and ambulatory care services, and an academic space for the UBC Faculty of Medicine. Learn more about Williams Lake’s medical and general communities on the Central Interior Rural Division of Family Practice’s website. CARIBOO MEMORIAL HOSPITAL Cariboo Memorial Hospital (CMH) is undergoing a big transformation with planned completion in 2029! Currently, CMH is a Level 2 Community Hospital in Williams Lake, with 28 inpatient beds. At CMH, we offer a broad spectrum of services, including emergency medicine, internal medicine, general surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, orthopedic surgery, pediatrics, psychiatry, anesthesia, and hospitalist services. Laboratory services, diagnostic imaging, and outpatient hemodialysis units are available on-site. APPLY If you have your CCFP, CCFP (EM), or FRCPC in Emergency Medicine, we want to hear from you. While emergency experience is an asset, you’ll have access to mentorship whether you’re a new Canadian graduate or an international medical graduate. Apply today to live, work and play where others only vacation! It's better here! review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager/Director - EMEA
review_candidates.description: FrankieOne's UK and Nordic markets are wide open: tightening AML and financial crime regulation, KYC/KYB budgets under real board-level scrutiny, and incumbents who haven't kept pace with orchestration-led buying. We've already got a GM and presales team on the ground in London. What's missing is the person who turns that groundwork into signed revenue. Are you ready to build a region from the ground up, not manage one that's already been built? If so, we'd love to hear from you. As the Business Development Manager/Director - EMEA , you will own and grow FrankieOne's presence across a named-account territory of 30–50 enterprise and upper-mid-market targets in the UK and Nordics — a market where identity, fraud, KYC and AML solutions aren't nice-to-haves; they're the licence to operate. Reporting to the GM, Europe , you'll run the full cycle end to end: qualification through commercial close, security review, DPA/MSA negotiation and procurement. Deals typically run 4–9 months and involve 6–10 stakeholders — Head of Financial Crime/MLRO, Head of Risk, Product, Engineering and Procurement among them. This isn't a territory with brand recognition to lean on. You'll be building pipeline and credibility from a standing start, architecting consumption-based commercial models — per-verification pricing, volume tiers, minimum commits, orchestration vs. bundled-vendor economics — and feeding what you learn about pricing pressure, coverage gaps and competitive displacement straight back into Product and the EU operating plan. Your Ticket to Success Territory & Pipeline Ownership Build and run a named-account territory of 30–50 enterprise and upper-mid-market targets across the UK and Nordics. Own an annual new ARR quota, plus expansion revenue in the accounts you land. Develop your own pipeline in a market with limited brand recognition — no inbound safety net. Consultative, Compliance-Led Selling Navigate multi-stakeholder deals — typically 6–10 stakeholders including Head of Financial Crime/MLRO, Head of Risk, Product, Engineering and Procurement. Hold credible, unassisted conversations on KYC/KYB, AML screening, sanctions, PEP and perpetual KYC. Run 4–9 month enterprise cycles from qualification through security review, DPA/MSA negotiation and procurement sign-off. Commercial & Deal Architecture Structure consumption-based commercial models: per-verification pricing, volume tiers, minimum commits, and orchestration vs. bundled-vendor economics. Defend price against procurement-led cost-reduction mandates, backed by a real grasp of unit economics and the margin implications of over-verification. Forecast honestly — no sandbagging, no happy ears — using MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or equivalent. Market Intelligence & Category Building Feed structured market feedback into Product and the EU operating plan — pricing pressure, coverage gaps, competitive displacement patterns. Operate with genuine autonomy, reporting into a GM who's also building the market — low supervision, high accountability. In a Previous Life, You Have 7+ years closing enterprise deals with £250k+ ACV in B2B SaaS within FinTech or RegTech, including at least three years selling into regulated financial services — with evidence of consistent quota attainment at that deal size, not one outlier year. Sold to compliance, risk or financial crime buyers, and can hold your own on KYC/KYB, AML screening, sanctions, PEP, perpetual KYC or transaction monitoring without a solutions engineer translating for you. Built a territory with little brand recognition — founding-BDM or first-in-region experience, or a documented move from a market-leading vendor to a challenger where you still hit number. Comfort navigating technical and API-led products — integration, latency, data residency and false-positive/pass-rate discussions, without deferring every question. Commercial literacy on consumption pricing — unit economics, margin implications of over-verification, and how to defend price against a procurement-led cost-reduction mandate. A rigorous qualification methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or equivalent) and an honest forecast. Genuine autonomy — comfortable with low supervision and high accountability. Also Great If You've Got Direct experience in identity verification, fraud, or AML — from a vendor such as Sumsub, Trulioo, Entrust/Onfido, Veriff, Persona, Alloy, Socure, Fourthline, or from an orchestration platform. Crypto/digital-assets exchange relationships, or iGaming operator relationships. Nordic market experience. Experience selling through or with data/screening partners.
